free_tier.stated: API-Inference is offered free of charge to registered developers, with real-time dynamic limits on quota and concurrency; calls can also be redeemed by magicubes (0.5 to 2 per call). The official docs state no fixed numeric daily quota on this page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints with a ModelScope access token
chaining: dynamic per-model concurrency limits and the real-name gate are the scarce links

limits.value: concurrency is dynamically rate-limited by platform load; no fixed numeric quota stated on this page

identity_cost.detail: the ModelScope account must be linked to an Alibaba Cloud account that has completed real-name verification before API-Inference can be used

reliability_note: the service is non-commercial and not for high-concurrency or SLA-dependent online tasks; older models may be removed

notes: The official doc page (modelscope.cn/docs/...) returned broker-exit-1 on every route; the first-party text was captured from resouces.modelscope.cn, ModelScope's official documentation CDN search result. A real-name verified Alibaba Cloud account is required, which a registrant without a PRC identity cannot supply. The commonly cited 2,000-daily-call figure appears only in a community post and is not on the captured official page, so it is not used as a documented number.
